notes: Batch 2 «ذخیره امن» (v1.11.61) — Groups 02+04 of the grouped audit. (1) M-DATA2: testbook saves are book-level merged on the server — books present in the new body replace the same-id book, books absent from the body are preserved from disk — so two tabs no longer wipe each other's books; a book-level merge would resurrect a deliberately deleted book, so no book-delete UI may rely on absence (same caveat as PR1/daysDone). (2) L-PERF2: testbook saves serialized on tbSaveQueue. (3) L-DATA5: local fallback box ids carry a random suffix (localBoxId), and the createBoxIdempotent recovery GET retries once. (4) L-PERF8: POST /api/state returns only {ok: true} (~117KB saved per save). (5) F8: bulkUndoPoint reads /api/backup/list as the flat array the server returns — the 30s undo toast works again. (6) M-DATA1: flushSaves() returns a success boolean; bulk delete restores the boxes in memory and reports «حذف نشد» when the save fails; reverse plan checks too. (7) M-UI7/L-UI6/L-UI8: bulk-delete section moved to the end of the Remaining tab inside a collapsed <details>; only the 3 freshest day groups open, with a collapse-all button; the filtered-empty state uses the shared emptyState with a clear-filters action. (8) L-UI9: backup version rows show Jalali date + size, filename in the tooltip. PR1 is NOT fixed here — it needs the user's save-sequence/ETag design decision. i18n 1333/1333 (2 new keys: bdDeleteFailed, pastCollapseAll).
